text: Welcome.
Let this be your place to return.
Not to accomplish anything, but simply to rest in the quiet of your own presence.
Take a breath in through your nose and let it go through your mouth.
Inhale gently, exhale slowly, allow your eyes to close if they haven't already.
And begin to feel the weight of your body settling down.
Feel the pull of gravity welcoming you.
The surface beneath you holds you fully.
You don't need to carry anything here.
Let your breath settle.
Let your thoughts drift like leaves on still water.
Now, bring your awareness to the space above your head.
Imagine a soft, quiet light there.
Not bright, not intense.
Just steady, like the last warmth of the sun before dusk.
This light is not separate from you.
It's part of you.
It's the part that remains calm, even when the surface moves.
The part of you that always knows how to rest.
Let this light slowly move to the top of your head.
And as it arrives, feel it easing across your scalp, softening the forehead.
Releasing the space around your eyes.
Let it move into your cheeks.
Your jaw.
Your throat.
There is nothing to hold here.
Let the light support it all.
With every breath, feel the light expanding downward.
Into your shoulders.
Your chest.
Your heart center.
Let it fill this space without effort.
A quiet radiance.
Warm.
And gentle.
You don't need to do anything to feel it.
Just allow.
Let this light continue down your spine.
Your abdomen.
Your hips.
Down through your legs.
All the way to your feet.
Your entire body is now held in this soft inner glow.
Your body is now held in this soft inner glow.
